scripts.build:ios: vite build --mode ios && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:device: npm run build:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination id=${IOS_DEVICE_ID:?Set IOS_DEVICE_ID to your iPhone UDID} -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=${IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:?Set IOS_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM to your Apple signing team ID} build && xcrun devicectl device install app --device ${IOS_DEVICE_ID} ios/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app
